Iterative fit of smoothed doubled angles at the observation points

Source: R/interpolation.R
dot-hm_fit.Rd

Objective per observation i (Hansen & Mount 1990, eq. 5; Müller et al. 2003, eq. 3): M_i = q_i delta_i y_i y_i^T + lambda * sum_j w~_ij delta_j f_j f_j^T. The identity part of y y^T does not change the dominant eigenvector, so only the doubled-angle components (cos 2a, sin 2a) are carried.

Usage

.hm_fit(nb, n, th2, q, lambda, n_iter, tol, robust_scale = 0)

Arguments

robust_scale

minimum robustness scale in chord units (2 * sin(deg / 2)), see circular_smooth().
